node_definition.done_when: The measurement report at /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/reports/reckon/s22-coord/five-ledger-cases-turned-red/report.md is the brief; its repair option 1 is the change. The five tests/test_ledger.py cases it names pass at head without editing tests/test_ledger.py. A new tests/test_a_live_worker_still_owes_its_review.py promotes a run with a terminal manifest and a provably live worker pid: with no review and no waiver it is refused, and with the review waiver it is admitted. The named negative control (restore review_required's classification-only reading) makes the no-waiver case promote unreviewed. Before editing, the worker measures which tests pass at base only because the gate is open, by closing it in a scratch copy, and records their ids. Any such test outside this fence is not edited: the manifest reads blocked and names each id for a scope widening. The gate is every test file that imports reckon.crew.promotion, run with -n 8 at base and at head. Both suite arms are recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with no placeholder, and each log ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. The head arm adds no failure id. An evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-is-green-at-head/a-live-worker-still-owes-its-review.html records the change. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
node_definition.goal: complete() in reckon/crew/promotion.py decides whether a run owes a review from the delivery it promotes (a terminal manifest, the passing verdict, the run's review tier), so a run whose worker process is still alive owes the review its tier requires (followup f-sgh-five-ledger-cases-turned-red).
